name: Death & Taxes
notes: Faithful 60-card Legacy Mono-White Death & Taxes. Disruptive creatures (Thalia, Mother of Runes), land denial (Rishadan Port, Wasteland), and a Stoneforge equipment package. ENGINE-RISK (faithful, no-compromise build): Aether Vial (counter cheat-in), Stoneforge Mystic (fetch+cheat equipment), Umezawa's Jitte / Batterskull / Sword of Fire and Ice (equipment), Flickerwisp/Palace Jailer (blink/monarch), Mother of Runes (activated protection), Karakas (legend bounce). The Vial + Stoneforge + equip lines are exactly the kind of multi-step value CP7 fumbles.
